landing_hero_badge: The easiest exam platform for teachers
landing_hero_desc: Run online and paper exams, get answers graded automatically, and keep results, analytics and report cards in one place.
landing_features_subheading: From writing questions to report cards — a teacher's whole workflow on one platform
landing_how_register_desc: Sign up in just 30 seconds with email or Google account.
landing_how_test_desc: Write questions, cut them from a PDF or pick them from your question bank.
landing_how_results_desc: Answers are graded automatically; results and analytics are ready right away.
landing_pricing_subheading: Choose a plan that fits your needs

crop_autotrim_tip: White space around the box is removed automatically
crop_hint_draw: Drag a box around the part you need. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel.

landing_feat_types_desc: Multiple choice, picture, short answer, numeric, long answer and passage-based questions, with formulas and images.
landing_feat_pdf_desc: Cut questions out of an existing PDF or image and turn them into an exam in minutes.
landing_feat_bank_desc: Keep questions in folders and add a whole folder, or N random questions from it, to an exam.
landing_feat_online_desc: Assign an exam to a class and set the time and duration. Answers save automatically and the exam is handed in when time runs out.
landing_feat_fair_desc: Questions and choices are shuffled for each student and tab switches are shown to the teacher. You decide when students see the answers.
landing_feat_paper_desc: Print variants, get the answer key and enter the results into the system. Sheets carry a watermark with your name.
landing_feat_grading_desc: A 100-point scale, pass mark, equal points per question and DİM-style net scores.
landing_feat_analytics_desc: Class and student statistics, charts, printable student report cards and Excel export.
landing_feat_classes_desc: Create classes and give students sign-ins — no email needed. The platform speaks Azerbaijani, Russian and English.

pwa_install_desc: Open it with one tap from your home screen
pwa_ios_step1: In Safari, tap the Share button
pwa_offline: No internet connection. Work will continue once you are back online.
